items.title: Stefon Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2020
items.q: Michelle Reiser-Memmer hosted the event and participated in the audience Q&A. [INTERVIEWER] addresses her as 'Michelle' to ask questions of Mr. Harris.

ctx.x: Vibraphonist Stefon Harris’ passionate artistry and virtuosity have propelled him to the forefront of the jazz scene. He has been called one of the most important artists in jazz by the L.A. Times and he has earned four Grammy nominations and was chosen best vibes in 2017 and ’18 by DownBeat magazine’s Critics Poll. Michelle Reiser-Memmer hosted the event and participated in the audience Q&A.
Stefon was interviewed via Zoom on November 11, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
